instruction.name: rdtimeh.w
instruction.description: Read the stable counter into rd and the timer ID into rj.

throughput.name: rj == 0, 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: rdtimeh.w $r12, $r0; rdtimeh.w $r13, $r0; rdtimeh.w $r14, $r0; rdtimeh.w $r15, $r0; rdtimeh.w $r16, $r0; rdtimeh.w $r17, $r0; rdtimeh.w $r18, $r0; rdtimeh.w $r19, $r0
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --asm 'rdtimeh.w $r12, $r0; rdtimeh.w $r13, $r0; rdtimeh.w $r14, $r0; rdtimeh.w $r15, $r0; rdtimeh.w $r16, $r0; rdtimeh.w $r17, $r0; rdtimeh.w $r18, $r0; rdtimeh.w $r19, $r0'
